## Pull Request Checklist

### Description

- **Problem:**
  - Describe the problem that this PR addresses.

- **Solution:**
  - Describe the solution implemented in this PR and how it integrates with the extension.

- **Testing:**
  - Explain how this PR was tested and validated, including browser compatibility.
  - [ ] Tested in Chrome
  - [ ] Tested in Edge (if applicable)
  - [ ] No console errors
  - [ ] Extension loads correctly
  - [ ] Features work as expected

### Type of Change

- [ ] Feature work
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Engineering change
- [ ] Test
- [ ] Security fix
- [ ] Performance improvement

### Impact Assessment

- **Risk:**
  - [ ] High – Errors could cause MAJOR regression of many scenarios.
  - [ ] Medium – Errors could cause regression of 1 or more scenarios.
  - [ ] Small – No issues are expected.

- **Breaking Changes:**
  - [ ] Yes (Describe below)
  - [ ] No

### Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or errors
- [ ] I have tested that my changes work correctly
- [ ] I have checked version numbers are consistent (if applicable)

### Related Issues

- Fixes #(issue number)
- Related to #(issue number)

### Screenshots (if applicable)

Add screenshots to demonstrate the changes, especially for UI modifications.

### Additional Notes

Add any additional context or notes for reviewers here.
